# FINO

> Il Futuro È Ora. The future of work is human. FINO is a two-person practice founded by Anna Milaeva and Dario Giuffrida that works on both operating systems a team runs on: the inner one, made of people, and the outer one, made of process and tools.

Every team runs two systems at once. The outer system is the one everyone can see: the workflows, the tools, the calendar, the way decisions get made. The inner system is the one running inside the people: what happens under pressure, what gets avoided, who goes quiet. Most work addresses one and wonders why it did not hold. FINO works with both, and takes engagements where only one is needed. We work with small and medium businesses, professional firms and startups, typically ten to a hundred people, and we do the work ourselves.

## Founders

- [About FINO](https://fino.website/about/): Anna Milaeva, trained through Level 3 at the IFS Institute, Certified Deep Transformational Coach, over a decade running operations inside fast-moving organizations, author of the novel Already In A Meeting, works in English, Spanish and Russian. Dario Giuffrida, organizational psychologist and IFS practitioner, twenty years facilitating groups and building communities, musician and songwriter, works in English, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese.

## Inner operations

- [Self-leadership Circles](https://fino.website/circles/): eight weeks, once a week, online, for a team of eight to sixteen. Parts work is the map; the material is whatever the team is carrying that week. From $600 per person.
- [Leadership Coaching](https://fino.website/coaching/): one to one and small groups, grounded in Internal Family Systems, for leaders looking at what is actually driving their decisions. Six sessions to start, from $1,500.
- [Non-ordinary Offsites](https://fino.website/offsites/): two to five days in nature, in the USA and Europe, designed with you and held with practitioners who bring movement, music, ceremony and breathwork.
- The Self-leadership Intensive: half a day with a team, usually online, from $1,500. How most teams find out whether they want the eight weeks.

## Outer operations

- [Fractional Operations](https://fino.website/fractional-operations/): one operations partner inside the work. We find what is costing the team the most time and fix it, built into how the team already works and handed over so it keeps running. Ninety days recommended, from $3,500 a month, month to month with two weeks notice.
- [Operations for Law Firms](https://fino.website/law-firms/): for firms that grew faster than the way they run. Case management selection and migration, scheduling, document generation, billing capture, internal tools and AI policy. Includes a genuinely free mediation scheduling tool at https://scheduler.fino.website with no account required.
- [Self-led AI Integration](https://fino.website/self-led-ai-integration/): three things in one order, the people who will use it, the work they actually do, and then the tools. Workshops and an embedded build, taken together or separately. Sixty to ninety days, from $3,500 a month.
- [FINO Studio](https://fino.website/studio/): websites and internal tools for coaches, therapists, consultants and independent practitioners. We interview you first and everything follows from that.

## Credentials

Approved US Federal Contractor. Florida Bar CLE Provider. Trained at the IFS Institute. Based in the USA and Europe, working online globally and in person across both continents, in English, Spanish, Russian, Italian and Portuguese.

## The book

- [Already In A Meeting](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HD3GVY6Z/): a novel by Anna Milaeva. Five colleagues, one company in trouble, and the second meeting that runs inside each person while the first one happens. Paperback, Kindle, and free on Kindle Unlimited.
